questions.passage: Why do people who are high in openness to experience tend to lead psychologically rich lives? Open people are imaginative, curious, and interested in intellectual and artistic pursuits. People low in openness are conventional and down-to-earth, preferring routine and less interested in intellectual or artistic pursuits. Students who are open to experience are more likely to study abroad, an activity known to enhance psychological richness, than those low in openness.
questions.prompt: Which tendency is specifically reported for students high in openness?
options: They are less likely to pursue intellectual interests.
They prefer routine more than students low in openness.
They are more likely to study abroad than less open students.
They all choose the same artistic subject at university.
questions.promptZh: 本段具体报告高开放性学生具有哪种倾向？
optionsZh: 较不愿追求知识兴趣。
比低开放性学生更偏好惯例。
比低开放性学生更可能留学。
大学里全部选择同一种艺术学科。
analyses: A 原文说 open people 对知识和艺术有兴趣。
B preferring routine 修饰低开放性者。
C 最后一句明确比较留学可能性；more likely 不等于所有人。
D 没有统一选科的信息，也不能把倾向扩成全体。

evidence.quote: Students who are open to experience are more likely to study abroad

vocabulary.context: intellectual and artistic pursuits 指知识与艺术方面的兴趣活动，不限于正式学位
vocabulary.example: She makes time for artistic pursuits after work.

questions.translation: 为什么经验开放性高的人往往过着心理丰富的人生？开放的人富于想象、好奇，对知识和艺术活动有兴趣。开放性低的人则较传统、脚踏实地，偏好惯例，对知识或艺术活动较少兴趣。与开放性低的学生相比，开放的学生更可能留学；留学是一项已知能增进心理丰富性的活动。

questions.passage: The .47 correlation also means that having an open personality doesn’t necessarily guarantee that you will lead a psychologically rich life. Joy Ryan, the ninety-four-year-old national park enthusiast we met in Chapter 4, might have always been open to experience. But, until she turned eighty-five, she hadn’t had many opportunities to explore the world. Once she was exposed to Smoky Mountain National Park, she was hooked.
questions.prompt: What does 'might have always been open' allow the author to suggest about Joy Ryan?
questions.promptZh: might have always been open 允许作者对 Joy Ryan 作什么判断？
options: Her lifelong openness has been measured and proved without uncertainty.
She was certainly closed to experience before eighty-five.
She may have had an open disposition even before opportunities to explore expanded.
Her openness alone guaranteed that she travelled widely throughout her life.
optionsZh: 她终生开放已被测量并无疑证实。
她八十五岁前肯定不开放。
在探索机会增加前，她可能本已具有开放倾向。
仅开放性就保证她一生一直广泛旅行。
analyses: A might 保留推测，非终生测量证明。
B 把可能一直开放反写为确定不开放。
C 与后文缺少机会相结合，有限推论区分性格和探索机会。
D 父段明确开放不保证丰富，机会约束不能省略。

vocabulary.context: 对过去状态保留不确定性，不能当已证实历史数据。
vocabulary.example: She might have known about the plan before the meeting.

questions.passage: Besides opportunities and resources, intellectual and artistic abilities are also factors. Simon Ramo, whose New York Times obituary was rated as particularly psychologically rich, was an aerospace engineer. He earned a PhD in physics and engineering from the California Institute of Technology and later developed intercontinental ballistic missiles, or ICBMs. He published sixty-two books over the course of his life; he had twenty-five patents before he was thirty, and earned his final patent at age one hundred.
questions.prompt: Which account correctly preserves the timing of Simon Ramo’s patents?
options: He received all twenty-five patents at age one hundred.
He received his final patent before turning thirty.
He had sixty-two patents before he was thirty.
He had twenty-five patents before thirty and his last at one hundred.
questions.promptZh: 哪项正确保留了 Simon Ramo 获专利的时间信息？
optionsZh: 全部二十五项专利都在一百岁取得。
最后一项专利在三十岁前取得。
三十岁前有六十二项专利。
三十岁前有二十五项，一百岁获得最后一项。
analyses: A 把早年专利与晚年最后一项合并为同一时间。
B 原文最后一项在 age one hundred。
C sixty-two 指书的数量，不是专利数。
D twenty-five...before...thirty 与 final...one hundred 分别对应；这是个人事例，不证明所有高智力者必然如此。

evidence.quote: he had twenty-five patents before he was thirty, and earned his final patent at age one hundred.

vocabulary.context: 指发明获得的专利；须与本段另一个数字“六十二本书”区分
vocabulary.example: The engineer holds several patents for medical devices.

questions.translation: 除了机会与资源，智力与艺术能力也是因素。Simon Ramo 是航天工程师，他在《纽约时报》的讣告被评为特别心理丰富。他在 California Institute of Technology 获得物理与工程博士学位，后来研制洲际弹道导弹，即 ICBM。他一生出版六十二本书，三十岁前已有二十五项专利，一百岁取得最后一项专利。
